events.title: Maverik before shift - Dale

events.title: Northwest - line 2

events.title: Drop off boot receipt + size sheet

events.title: Find Kootenai login / old paperwork

events.title: Gov Way papers + furnace video

events.title: Garage: sand stool legs, check bike fairing

events.title: Hank/Joyce tin + Maverik

events.title: Patricia - Hayden stop
events.notes: Sign in at front desk. Bring Bakery by the Lake box if there is time after work.

events.title: Clean out truck bins

events.title: Watch CDA council stream: complaint review + officer training item

events.title: Cody - south ramp before first light

events.notes: Bring poles, spare socks, coffee cash. Check roster note before leaving.
